title: Exposure Control Plan For Bloodborne Pathogens

revisions.message: Publish 4119.42-E PDF(1) E PDF: Exposure Control Plan For Bloodborne Pathogens
revisions.body:
Hepatitis B Vaccine DeclinationI understand that due to my occupational exposure to blood or other potentially infectious materials Imay be at risk of acquiring hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. I have been given the opportunity to be
vaccinated with hepatitis B vaccine, at no charge to myself.
However, I decline hepatitis B vaccination
at this time.
I understand that by declining this vaccine, I continue to be at risk of acquiring hepatitis B,
a serious disease.
If in the future I continue to have occupational exposure to blood or other potentially
infectious materials and I want to be vaccinated with hepatitis B vaccine, I can receive the vaccination
series at no charge to myself.
